description: List the checkpoints saved in the project (one per Claude Code session, plus a legacy .claude-checkpoint if present), newest first, with each one's goal, last-saved time, branch and whether all its tasks are done. Use it when the user wants to resume a different or older session; load one with load_session_checkpoint's `checkpoint`.

limit.description: Maximum number of checkpoints to return, newest first. 0 returns all of them.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project. Defaults to the client's workspace root or the server's working directory.

session.description: This conversation's session id, as returned by an earlier save. Omit on Claude Code. Not for picking a checkpoint to read: use load_session_checkpoint's checkpoint, then resumedFrom.

name: list_session_checkpoints
title: List session checkpoints
